description.text:
The Happy Set Dragonite & Mewtwo & Camerupt & Sinistcha (宝可梦卡牌 嗨皮组合 快龙&超梦&喷火驼&来悲粗茶) came out on 16 July 2026, the fifth Happy Set. Like the others, it is a box for two to four friends, new players or old hands, to play together. It held four new ready-to-play 60-card decks, each with a card explaining how it plays. Dragonite ex's attack does 280 damage if a coin lands heads, and Potion and the Supporter Cook heal it so it can keep attacking. Mewtwo ex's attack grows with the Psychic Energy on its player's Pokémon, and Xatu's Ability attaches Energy to the Bench and draws cards. Camerupt's attack discards the top card of each deck and does 250 damage if both are Energy, so Deduction Kit and Team Star Grunt set up the top of the decks. Sinistcha's attack discards up to three Grass Energy from its player's Pokémon for up to 210 damage, and Porygon-Z's Ability can, on a heads, attach up to four basic Energy from the discard pile to itself. With luck one of the four decks was a holo deck, the same cards in holo, which turned up 1.6% of the time.

The box also held a beginner's guide, two battle guides, damage counters and two coins, rules for two to four players, a 10-card modification pack for strengthening a deck between games, a one-card reward pack, shared out by the results, and seven two-card Happy Packs (嗨皮包), shared out by the number of games won. A Happy Deck (嗨皮卡组) box holding one of the four decks at random came out the same day. Its cards are numbered out of 58; five basic Energy, Fire, Grass, Lightning, Psychic and Water, print their type code instead of a number.
